'''Zayda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] who lived during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At some point, he acquired the custom-made [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[RX-7246]] for use as his personal combat assistant and he entered the service of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Darga Jiramma Mionne]]. In about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Zayda and RX-7246 participated in a gladiator fight in [[Darga the Hutt's palace|Darga's palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], fighting against the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Karg brothers]] and a group of undercover [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents.
